finalText:
**Redis died and took the service with it.**

`logs/app.log`, 719 lines, all one incident.

```
02:14:07 ERROR [api] redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379
02:31:52 FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down
```

Cache fell back to direct store reads. Store overloaded. Queues grew, passed max 500, kept growing to 568. `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`, exit 134. All 13 Redis reconnects failed. Log ends dead.
